update_knowledge.description: Ingest documents into the knowledge base. Ingestion is idempotent on content hash: unchanged documents are skipped and reported, so a scheduled refresh does not grow the corpus with duplicates. This is the only tool that writes anywhere, and only to the operator's own local knowledge database.

request.description: Documents to ingest into the knowledge base.

documents.description: Optional explicit document bodies, aligned with urls. Use when the caller already has the text and no fetch is wanted.

skipped_unchanged.description: Documents whose content hash matched the last ingestion.
